title: BRIDGE the Gap: Mitigating Bias Amplification in Automated Scoring of English Language Learners via Inter-group Data Augmentation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring bias amplification (BiasAmp) by comparing the disparity in high-score rates between English Language Learners (ELLs) and non-ELL students in model predictions versus ground truth training data. Also evaluating the Mean Score Gap (MSG) difference between groups.
